scope: Mobile hotbar scrolling with a second finger while the joystick stays held.

targeted_tests.method: Real runtime functions with a capture/bubble event harness, pointer capture transfer and the production game releasePointer handler.
coverage: A non-primary touch scrolls the hotbar while the joystick retains its pointer and movement vector.
Transfer of implicit capture from a spell button to the viewport does not terminate the swipe.
A swipe, including return to its starting position, never casts; compatibility clicks are suppressed.
A subsequent spell tap and native mouse/keyboard clicks still activate normally.
Separate pointer IDs, cancellation, disabled-slot/gap starts and scroll bounds are handled independently.
Desktop mode and a non-overflowing hotbar do not capture the scrolling gesture.

source_review: Mobile viewport and slots use touch-action none with scroll snapping disabled.
Pointer capture begins only beyond the 12-pixel horizontal swipe threshold, preserving taps.
Disabled mobile slots allow gestures to start on the underlying viewport.
Pointerup continues to the game handler; scrolling does not reset joystick controls.
deployment: Local source and release packages only; no live deployment or player database changes.
